CaseStudy.heading: One year. One client. From a tired WordPress site to a site that's still running.

client.heading: The client and the problem
client.body: Improve Invest is a property fund that transforms older buildings. When they came to us, their website had been built in WordPress years earlier — and it showed. It was slow, hard to update, and it didn't look like the serious investment company they are.

work.heading: What we did
work.body: We started from scratch and kept going for a year, in close dialogue with the client.
items: A new website built from scratch in Next.js — no templates, no WordPress baggage
The site went from Danish-only to Danish, German and English
Responsiveness fixed on every device, tested on real phones and tablets
A full redesign with animations and clickable prototypes we refined together
Their client-facing Excel workbook made presentable: front page, colour, clickable interface

collaboration.heading: How we worked together
collaboration.body: For a year we worked as their team, not just their supplier. We met regularly, showed prototypes, listened and adjusted. No account managers in between — when they wrote, we answered. By the end, we knew their business well enough to suggest the next move ourselves.

result.heading: The result
result.body: A fast, modern website in three languages that looks the way the company is: professional. Still live, still maintained, still evolving. That's what a year of working together looks like.

contact.heading: Would you like the same for your website?
contact.body: Tell us where your website stands today. We'll give you an honest assessment of what's worth doing — whether that's a new build, a modernisation or a better language.

AboutPage.title: About
AboutPage.description: The two people behind SaRe — a Copenhagen studio that builds, modernises and maintains websites.

AboutIntro.heading: We are SaRe.
AboutIntro.content:
A two-person website studio in Copenhagen. We build, modernise and maintain websites for businesses that want them done properly.

No account managers, no middlemen. When you hire us, you work directly with the two people who build your website.

founders.name: Daniel Saleh
founders.role: Co-founder — builds and maintains the websites.
founders.background: Daniel is the one who does the building. He has built, modernised and maintained websites for businesses for years — and he cares about what happens after launch, not just on the day. He is the one who answers when you write, and the one who keeps your site running.

founders.name: Gustav Reumert
founders.role: Co-founder — makes sure the details are right.
founders.background: Gustav is the one who makes sure the details are right — the language, the design, the way it all fits together. He has written and translated website copy for Danish and international businesses, and he believes the small things are what make a site feel professional.

HowWeWork.heading: How we work
HowWeWork.description: Four things you can expect when you work with us:

features.heading: Direct lines
features.description: You write to us, not to an account manager. The person who answers is the person who does the work.

features.heading: Honest assessments
features.description: If your website doesn't need a rebuild, we'll tell you. We'd rather do a smaller job than a wrong one.

features.heading: Small team, short lines
features.description: Two people, no layers. Decisions are made where the work happens — usually the same day.

features.heading: Clear scope
features.description: You'll know what we deliver, when, and for what price — before we start.

features.heading: Plain-spoken
features.description: We say what we mean, in words you don't need a dictionary for. No jargon, no buzzwords, no theatre.

features.heading: Long-term relationships
features.description: We'd rather work with the same clients for years than chase one-off projects. That's how sites stay good long after launch.

features.heading: Substance over hype
features.description: We let the work speak for itself. A fast, reliable website says more than a page of superlatives.

AboutProof.content: We spent a year rebuilding one client's website from scratch — and we still maintain it today. That's how we like to work.
AboutProof.linkLabel: Read the full story on our Services page
